sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s or equivalent by matriculation; enrolled undergraduates may apply. UChicago math bachelor is an
eligible degree route; no published exclusion for UChicago undergraduate or international F1 status. Formal
eligibility is not an admission prediction. [s1] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Create Mathematics PhD application in PSD portal (not Bx/MS). Gather transcripts, at least three referees and
SOP; self-report optional GRE and send official scores if included. Briefly explain missing Math GRE. Fee-waiver
request only after applicant submission, before payment. [s1] [s2] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty sponsorship not necessary and no expectation of preapplication contact. Focused questions about
research/supervision welcome; verify availability especially Ngô’s HKU appointment. [s5]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
PSD portal supports separate applications per program. After submission status page provides fee waiver and
receipt tracking; new grades may be uploaded under Other Miscellaneous Documents. [s9] [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Autumn 2027 deadline explicit; stipend benchmark 2026-27. Some department fee/funding wording may lag
newer division policy. [s1] [s2] [s7]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Only TOEFL iBT (including Home Edition) or IELTS Academic/UKVI Academic accepted; IELTS One Skill Retake
requires original too. Department lists TOEFL90 and IELTS7.0; new TOEFL-scale math equivalent not verified.
Not needed if education exemption applies. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Automatic education waiver if at least one full academic year in last10years already completed full-time as
degree-seeking student at accredited English-medium institution in US/listed country. UChicago attendance
meets this assuming ordinary full-time completed year; remote/nondegree/research-only study does not. No
email waiver request needed. [s3]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional and accepted; no PSD minimum score. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
Optional but strongly encouraged. Applicant who omits Math Subject score must briefly explain why in
application. ETS1832; Mathematics department0703. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Math promises full tuition and living stipend; exact autumn 2027 offer amount unverified. PSD 2026-27 GRA
benchmark: USD47,741 gross12-month base, plusUSD5,517 insurance andUSD2,080 fees, effectiveOct 2026.
These are GRA budget rates, not verified 2027-28 first-year math fellowship. Tuition remission budget charge is
not extra cash. [s1] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Math admissions guarantees up to five years with satisfactory academic/teaching performance;
current-student teaching schedule discusses years3-6, so sixth-year guarantee cannot be inferred. [s1] [s6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
All admitted math students receive full aid; central FAQ explicitly gives international applicants equal
consideration for University awards for which eligible. [s1] [s5]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
No first-year teaching. Current math page describes year2 three College Fellow assignments and eight
assignments across years3-6; extra compensation if more than3in academic year. Summer support described
as contingent on NSF levels. Teaching English standards separate from admission English waiver. [s6]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Only Financial Data Form in application; no separate ordinary aid form. [s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
External fellowships encouraged; NSF/Defense examples on math page have citizenship-specific conditions and
are not automatically available to this applicant. Consult UChicagoGRAD fellowship resources for eligible
alternatives. [s6] [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD90,nonrefundable. Do not pay before waiver decision if requesting one. [s1] [s2]
Fee waiver [Conflict]
Conflict: math page says foreign applicants cannot receive waiver, but current PSD/central instructions list
current/expected UChicago degree recipients without nationality exclusion. Applicant has a plausible
UChicago-degree category; request via status page after submitting and before paying, verify portal decision.
PSD also lists Math REU/SUMSA and need/hardship routes. No explicit waiver-request cutoff found. [s1] [s2] [s10]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s or equivalent by matriculation; enrolled undergraduates may apply. UChicago math bachelor is an
eligible degree route; no published exclusion for UChicago undergraduate or international F1 status. Formal
eligibility is not an admission prediction. [s1] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Create Mathematics PhD application in PSD portal (not Bx/MS). Gather transcripts, at least three referees and
SOP; self-report optional GRE and send official scores if included. Briefly explain missing Math GRE. Fee-waiver
request only after applicant submission, before payment. [s1] [s2] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty sponsorship not necessary and no expectation of preapplication contact. Focused questions about
research/supervision welcome; verify availability especially Ngô’s HKU appointment. [s5]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
PSD portal supports separate applications per program. After submission status page provides fee waiver and
receipt tracking; new grades may be uploaded under Other Miscellaneous Documents. [s9] [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Autumn 2027 deadline explicit; stipend benchmark 2026-27. Some department fee/funding wording may lag
newer division policy. [s1] [s2] [s7]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
3 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. CST for complete/submitted autumn 2027 application. Committee does not
formally consider until required materials received; no public math-specific grace period. Final official degree
transcript required before autumn classes. [s1]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Admission automatically includes consideration for full aid; Financial Data Form within application, no separate
ordinary aid application/deadline. [s1]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Central guidance says official test reports must arrive by program deadline. Self-report GRE to allow review

UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]

degree-seeking student at accredited English-medium institution in US/listed country. UChicago attendance
meets this assuming ordinary full-time completed year; remote/nondegree/research-only study does not. No
email waiver request needed. [s3]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional and accepted; no PSD minimum score. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]

through status portal when available. Final official registrar records after acceptance. [s4] [s1]

portal prompts and formatting must be inspected before drafting. [s1] [s2]

Number and type [Standing rule]
At least three from people who know mathematical work and can assess graduate potential in detail. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No separate reference requirement stated for ordinary PhD aid; external awards may differ. Financial Data
Form included in application. [s1]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Central guidance advises entering references as soon as account created. Submitting a recommendation
request generates automatic email; exact current control label/trigger not shown publicly. Final application
submission is not necessary. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Reference requests can be made beforehand; add recommenders before applicant submission. Central FAQ
does not promise adding new recommenders after submission. [s5]

benchmark: USD47,741 gross12-month base, plusUSD5,517 insurance andUSD2,080 fees, effectiveOct 2026.

not extra cash. [s1] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Math admissions guarantees up to five years with satisfactory academic/teaching performance;
current-student teaching schedule discusses years3-6, so sixth-year guarantee cannot be inferred. [s1] [s6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
All admitted math students receive full aid; central FAQ explicitly gives international applicants equal
consideration for University awards for which eligible. [s1] [s5]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s or equivalent by matriculation; enrolled undergraduates may apply. UChicago math bachelor is an
eligible degree route; no published exclusion for UChicago undergraduate or international F1 status. Formal
eligibility is not an admission prediction. [s1] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Create Mathematics PhD application in PSD portal (not Bx/MS). Gather transcripts, at least three referees and
SOP; self-report optional GRE and send official scores if included. Briefly explain missing Math GRE. Fee-waiver
request only after applicant submission, before payment. [s1] [s2] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty sponsorship not necessary and no expectation of preapplication contact. Focused questions about
research/supervision welcome; verify availability especially Ngô’s HKU appointment. [s5]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
PSD portal supports separate applications per program. After submission status page provides fee waiver and
receipt tracking; new grades may be uploaded under Other Miscellaneous Documents. [s9] [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Autumn 2027 deadline explicit; stipend benchmark 2026-27. Some department fee/funding wording may lag
newer division policy. [s1] [s2] [s7]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
3 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. CST for complete/submitted autumn 2027 application. Committee does not
formally consider until required materials received; no public math-specific grace period. Final official degree
transcript required before autumn classes. [s1]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Admission automatically includes consideration for full aid; Financial Data Form within application, no separate
ordinary aid application/deadline. [s1]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Central guidance says official test reports must arrive by program deadline. Self-report GRE to allow review

while official report en route; this does not eliminate official reporting. GRE valid5years; required English
valid2years as of application deadline. [s2] [s3] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Exact autumn 2027 mathematics commitment date not established by reviewed department/PSD/central
application pages. Check offer, including any interim check-ins. [s1] [s5]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Only TOEFL iBT (including Home Edition) or IELTS Academic/UKVI Academic accepted; IELTS One Skill Retake
requires original too. Department lists TOEFL90 and IELTS7.0; new TOEFL-scale math equivalent not verified.
Not needed if education exemption applies. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Automatic education waiver if at least one full academic year in last10years already completed full-time as
degree-seeking student at accredited English-medium institution in US/listed country. UChicago attendance
meets this assuming ordinary full-time completed year; remote/nondegree/research-only study does not. No
email waiver request needed. [s3]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional and accepted; no PSD minimum score. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
Optional but strongly encouraged. Applicant who omits Math Subject score must briefly explain why in
application. ETS1832; Mathematics department0703. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload transcript for every college/university attended for credit, including grading key. Unofficial copy
acceptable initially; original-language plus certified English translation if relevant. Upload fall-grade update
through status portal when available. Final official registrar records after acceptance. [s4] [s1]

Separate math-course list/syllabi/description template not established on public math/PSD checklist. Current
portal prompts and formatting must be inspected before drafting. [s1] [s2]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
At least three from people who know mathematical work and can assess graduate potential in detail. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No separate reference requirement stated for ordinary PhD aid; external awards may differ. Financial Data
Form included in application. [s1]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Central guidance advises entering references as soon as account created. Submitting a recommendation
request generates automatic email; exact current control label/trigger not shown publicly. Final application
submission is not necessary. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Reference requests can be made beforehand; add recommenders before applicant submission. Central FAQ
does not promise adding new recommenders after submission. [s5]

Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Check submitted application/status portal for receipt of letters and scores. [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Request details/FERPA cannot be changed after sending; create corrected new request. Referee should contact
gradadmissions@uchicago.edu for errors. Interfolio accepted via unique document email and applicant
authorization in Interfolio, typically48hours. Later-cycle reuse not publicly verified. [s5]

Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Central guidance asks applicants to update resume/CV, but math public checklist does not confirm whether
upload mandatory/optional or specify length/format. Confirm in PSD application. [s4] [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required. Prompt paraphrase: reasons for mathematics graduate study, relevant education/experience absent
elsewhere, mathematical interests and post-PhD plans. Public page gives no word/page limit or typography;
use current application instructions. [s1]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Publications list [Unresolved]
Separate required/optional field, prompt, limit, format and upload-versus-link permissions not established from
public mathematics/PSD application pages. Do not assume silence means permitted or required. [s1] [s2]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
SOP incorporates mathematical interests; no separate research-interest file specified publicly. [s1]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
Separate math-course list/syllabi/description template not established on public math/PSD checklist. Current
portal prompts and formatting must be inspected before drafting. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Ordinary aid: Financial Data Form, no other special aid form stated. Exact financial short answers and any
separate named-award essays not publicly verified. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Brief explanation required if Math GRE omitted. Financial Data Form is referenced; exact fields/limits not public.
Central FAQ permits later new material, such as grades, via Other Miscellaneous Documents; this is not blanket
approval of unsolicited paper uploads. [s1] [s5]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Math promises full tuition and living stipend; exact autumn 2027 offer amount unverified. PSD 2026-27 GRA
benchmark: USD47,741 gross12-month base, plusUSD5,517 insurance andUSD2,080 fees, effectiveOct 2026.
These are GRA budget rates, not verified 2027-28 first-year math fellowship. Tuition remission budget charge is
not extra cash. [s1] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Math admissions guarantees up to five years with satisfactory academic/teaching performance;
current-student teaching schedule discusses years3-6, so sixth-year guarantee cannot be inferred. [s1] [s6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
All admitted math students receive full aid; central FAQ explicitly gives international applicants equal
consideration for University awards for which eligible. [s1] [s5]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
No first-year teaching. Current math page describes year2 three College Fellow assignments and eight
assignments across years3-6; extra compensation if more than3in academic year. Summer support described
as contingent on NSF levels. Teaching English standards separate from admission English waiver. [s6]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Only Financial Data Form in application; no separate ordinary aid form. [s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
External fellowships encouraged; NSF/Defense examples on math page have citizenship-specific conditions and
are not automatically available to this applicant. Consult UChicagoGRAD fellowship resources for eligible
alternatives. [s6] [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD90,nonrefundable. Do not pay before waiver decision if requesting one. [s1] [s2]
Fee waiver [Conflict]
Conflict: math page says foreign applicants cannot receive waiver, but current PSD/central instructions list
current/expected UChicago degree recipients without nationality exclusion. Applicant has a plausible
UChicago-degree category; request via status page after submitting and before paying, verify portal decision.
PSD also lists Math REU/SUMSA and need/hardship routes. No explicit waiver-request cutoff found. [s1] [s2] [s10]
